name: as.yearqtr.default
title: An Index Class for Quarterly Data

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An object that as.numeric can coerce.

origin.details: The default method calls as.yearqtr(as.numeric(x)). A numeric string is snapped with yearqtr. "2001 Q2" is not numeric, so it becomes NA instead of quarter 2.
origin.value: A numeric vector of class yearqtr.
origin.example:
x <- suppressWarnings(as.yearqtr.default(c("2001.5", "2001 Q2")))
cat(paste(sprintf("%.17g", as.numeric(x)), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Coerce to a Yearqtr through a numeric conversion.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A number, a numeric string, or a sequence of those.

translation.details: Each element is read with float, then passed to yearqtr. "2001.5" is quarter 3 of 2001. "2001 Q2" is not a number and becomes missing. as_yearqtr parses that same string as quarter 2.
translation.example:
import warnings
from zoo.yearqtr import as_yearqtr_default
with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter("ignore", RuntimeWarning)
    x = as_yearqtr_default(["2001.5", "2001 Q2"])
print(" ".join("NA" if v != v else format(float(v), ".17g") for v in x.value))
